learning_objective: The learner can identify agent failure modes caused by planning, tool execution, and efficiency, and explain how they differ from standard generation failures.

common_misconceptions.description: Believing agent failures are limited to standard AI generation errors rather than including planning, tool execution, and efficiency issues.
Assuming tool failures are the same across all tools instead of being tool-dependent and requiring independent testing.
Thinking the time an agent takes to complete a task is irrelevant even when deadlines make timeliness critical.
